text:
Maya R.: quick sync — we need a tight plan for the Engineer Bootcamp launch (tutorial + live workshop + reference repo). goal: 1K signups, clear funnel for inbound leads into sales/devrel.
Sam G.: timeline?
Maya R.: target dates: announce blog + repo Mon May 12, webinar Wed May 21, follow-up drip over 2 weeks.
Elena P.: sounds good. who owns the reference repo readiness and example app?
Lee: I can polish the refapp, add a small CI that runs the smoke tests. need a README walkthrough and 2 short tutorials (setup + one production tip).
Sarah T.: I'll draft the launch post and a companion tutorial. want to highlight performance benchmarks: cost/token improvements using dedicated vs hosted on a sample app.
Ashwin: I can run quick perf runs and attach a small table. prefer we state the baseline: small LLM (7B) default vs quantized + batching. will provide numbers by Fri.
Maya R.: inbound routing: marketing form -> CRM -> webhook to devrel slack channel. can we add a tag for "bootcamp" on leads so sales can prioritize?
Sam G.: yes. I'll update the form with hidden field utm_campaign=engineer_bootcamp and a lead_tag=bootcamp. send me the final URL.
Elena P.: copy for CTA should be short: "Join our free Engineer Bootcamp — learn inference best practices + hands-on refapp". landing will have a short survey question: team size + infra.
Sarah T.: also want an optional checkbox: "share my code usage metrics" (for follow-up benchmarking). good for later case studies.
Ashwin: for the benchmark narrative, recommend two callouts: 1) steady latency under sustained load, 2) 3-4x cost savings via caching+quantization in our profile. will attach graphs (PNG) and a single JSON with numbers.
Lee: for the repo I'll add a small script `scripts/produce-bench.sh` and a reproducible seed so results match blog screenshots.
Maya R.: promo plan: announcement to newsletter + tweet thread + partner cross-post. webinar invites via calendar + HubSpot automated reminders (2 days before, 1 hour before). webinar recording hosted on our docs and YouTube.
Sam G.: can devrel do a short screening call for high-intent signups? maybe the form question on team size will flag >50 employees leads.
Sarah T.: messaging iteration: keep first email light (what you'll build), second focuses on benchmarks + architecture tips, third is case study ask. subject A/B test on lines: "Engineer Bootcamp: Build a low-latency refapp" vs "Ship inference-ready apps — free bootcamp".
Elena P.: what about gated artifacts? repo public but workshop notebook requires signup — ok?
Maya R.: yes. public repo, gated workshop notebook + slide deck behind signup. ops-bot: Reminder: Calendar event "Engineer Bootcamp Webinar" created for 2025-05-21 17:00 UTC by Sarah T.
ops-bot: RSVP link: https://calendar.example.com/event/bootcamp-1768432100
Ashwin: for inbound routing, send websocket payload to `/hooks/devrel-leads` with fields: `email`, `company`, `lead_tag`. Sam, can you confirm the CRM mapping?
Sam G.: mapping confirmed. I'll add field `lead_source=marketing_bootcamp` and route to devrel queue for immediate follow-up within 48h.
Lee: I'll add a small CONTRIBUTING.md to the repo that mentions the workload profile and expected hardware so community can replicate benchmarks.
Sarah T.: copy checklist for launch post:
- hero summary (1 paragraph)
- 3 bullets: what you'll learn
- benchmark callout with link to graphs
- repo + quickstart snippet (code block)
- CTA to sign up for workshop
Maya R.: assign owners: blog/Sarah, repo/Lee, benchmarks/Ashwin, forms/Sam, promo/Sarah+Sam, follow-up cadence/Maya.
Sam G.: will set up UTM tracking and HubSpot form tonight. will post final URL in this thread.
Elena P.: I'll create the Notion doc for assets and tasks and share perms with the group.
Maya R.: perfect. one more thing — let's keep the technical narrative focused on production constraints (latency SLOs, cost tradeoffs). avoid deep model internals.
Sarah T.: noted.
Lee: quick question — do we want a mini challenge during the webinar for attendees? small prize + GitHub issue to submit.
Maya R.: yes, devrel can run that. prize: $500 credit + community badge.
Sam G.: final deliverables timeline:
- Fri: benchmark numbers (Ashwin)
- Mon: draft blog + repo ready (Sarah, Lee)
- Wed (May 21): webinar
Maya R.: amazing. thanks everyone. post any blockers here. I'll check back EOD.
Ashwin: will upload initial CSV of benchmark results to the Notion page.
Lee: I'll push a branch `bootcamp-launch` with README draft today.
Sarah T.: draft subject lines ready, will A/B test. posting content doc in Notion.
Sam G.: HubSpot form: https://hubspot.example.com/forms/bootcamp-1768432100 — set to capture utm_campaign and lead_tag.
Maya R.: :thumbsup: closing loop — we'll reconvene Tue for final checklist review.
